state.notes: At the pinned driver commit, ros_publishers.py appends the two RS gripper finger names and their derived metre-valued position/velocity/duplicated motor-effort entries after the six arm joints. The gripper effort unit is not documented, so it is unset.

arm_command.notes: Uncommissioned profile: this config deliberately leaves an executable command endpoint unset. The source-documented endpoint is evidence only, not authorization to create an action client or transmit a goal.

gripper.notes: The official command is a motor angle in radians, not a prismatic opening-width command. It is excluded from the generic JointCommand profile because that contract has no gripper action capability. The published /rebotarm/joint_states stream carries only the two derived metre-valued finger joints for the gripper, never the motor axis.

stop.notes: No dedicated or safety-rated emergency-stop interface was found in the inspected official driver source. Do not use software cancellation, disable, safe_home, or process exit as an E-stop.
